descricao.en: A record label dedicated to sonic and visual experimentation. A collective space where different projects, identities, and sounds coexist. From heavy and distorted riffs to cold, ethereal synthscapes. Each project carries its own voice, its own narrative, and its own visual identity. An ongoing archive of experiments, a space where boundaries are tested and the only commitment is to the art of sound.

A brutal collision of Industrial Metal and Electro-Industrial. Built on heavy, mechanical drum machines, distorted synths, and abrasive textures, the project creates an oppressive and claustrophobic atmosphere. The vocals are purely screamed, distorted, and aggressive, with no room for clean vocals or melody. It is the sound of pure mechanical fury, where every track is a relentless assault of noise and aggression.
Four tracks salvaged from the corrupted tapes of the wasteland. A raw, mechanical descent into the mind of a lone scavenger. Built on heavy drum machines, abrasive synths, and pure aggressive fury.

The vocals are aggressive and shouted, cutting through layers of heavy fuzz to create an intense, driving atmosphere.

A raw transmission from the wasteland. Engine roars and distorted riffs collide in a relentless display of speed and aggression. No clean vocals, no slow moments, just the pure, unfiltered sound of the chase.

descricao.en: Dark science fiction universe where sound and narrative merge to create an immersive, fictional world. Every release, whether music, visual, or story, is a fragment of a larger interconnected mythos. Transmissions from the void. The signal never stops.

The time traveler who never wins. Originally just a man who believed in his best friend, he was forced into a temporal loop when he piloted a time machine to prevent the invasion. Trapped in a cycle where every failure resets the day and throws him into a different era or planet, he is the ultimate tragic hero. He knows the name of everyone who will die, he knows the exact second the bombs will fall, yet he never stops trying. He is the anchor of the universe, the thread that connects the timelines, even if he is doomed to always arrive too late. The sound is defined by dark synthwave, outrun, and retrowave. Cold, nocturnal, and cinematic, it features pulsating basslines and melancholic synths. The vocal delivery is robotic, tired, and spoken more than sung, reflecting a man who has repeated the same words a thousand times in the dark.

The beginning, before the war and the machine. The pure friendship forged long before the ashes. It covers the tragedy of the attack, the fire that consumed a friend, and the agonizing decision to leave them behind to step into the unknown. It is the origin of the guilt that will fuel an eternal cycle.

descricao.en: The same morning. The same cold coffee. The same impending doom. It is the purest form of exhaustion and paranoia, where a new plan is tried and fails, while a mysterious crack in the system offers a glimpse of something else.

An ancient desert civilization. A prophet of doom in a land that refuses to listen. The isolation of speaking a truth no one wants to hear, and the heavy burden of watching the inevitable unfold from a distance.

A space station, the first target before the world below. A claustrophobic and high-stakes attempt to hack the system and evacuate the innocent. It is the brutal dilemma of trying to buy time against a machine that fights back, knowing the station is destined to burn.

A quiet and melancholic return to the homeworld, before the fire. The heavy weight of allegiance and the desperate attempt to save a doomed world. It is the heartbreaking acceptance that the loop will eventually pull him away again, leaving only the realization that the war remains the same, and only the sky changes.

An intergalactic archaeologist from a peaceful, bureaucratic civilization. He investigates dead planets in search of lost civilizations. Obsessed with his work, he is a solitary man who feels more at home among ruins and dust than among the living. The ultimate seeker of truth, driven by a stubborn refusal to give up, even when the truth he uncovers is ignored by his own people. The sound is defined by progressive rock. It features hypnotic riffs, a distorted bass driving the rhythm, and tribal, mathematical drums. The vocals are deep and intense, balancing between a controlled whisper and a powerful release. It is the sound of discovery, dust, and ancient stones.
The heavy silence of a choice made long ago. It is the quiet certainty of a soul that traded a normal life for the cold vastness of the stars and the dust of forgotten ruins.

descricao.en: The routine, the method, and the frustration of the search. Lonely scans and drillings on a dead planet. It captures the relentless repetition of looking for signs of life in the stone, dealing with the silence of the universe and the slow, methodical process of reading the ground.

The shift from routine to wonder. The slow, careful uncovering of something that was never meant to be found. It is the awe and the eerie silence of walking through a civilization that time forgot, where the dust holds secrets older than memory itself.

The investigation of a tragedy. Digging through the remnants of a horrific end, a theory begins to form. But the evidence refuses to align. It is a descent into forensic detail, paranoia, and the heavy burden of uncovering a truth that does not perfectly fit.

The discovery of a truth that was never meant to be found. An account of something impossible, buried in the dust of a dead world. It is the crushing weight of knowing, and the quiet tragedy of being ignored by those who refused to listen. A legacy left behind for a future that may never come.

The silence in a world that screams. Living in a dystopian, colonized urban center, she represents the psychological erosion caused by an oppressive regime. While the world reacts with anger, this is the slow, agonizing dissolution of identity. Suffering from memory loss and depersonalization, it is someone standing at their own front door, holding a key that no longer fits, wondering if they ever belonged there at all. The sound is defined by darkwave, coldwave, EBM, and minimal synthwave. Cold, hypnotic, and club-oriented, it is driven by pulsating basslines and atmospheric synths. The vocal delivery is dry, distant, and intimate, narrating the horror of looking into a mirror and not recognizing the face staring back. It is the sound of the void.

Fragmented memories of a past that might not be real. The terrifying void of recognizing familiar faces but feeling nothing. It culminates in front of a mirror that reflects nothing but the initial shock of losing oneself.

descricao.en: The full dissolution of existence. A reality where every familiar space becomes alien, and the reflection of a life once lived now belongs to someone else. It is the claustrophobic horror of being erased from existence, carrying the unbearable question of who is left when the identity is gone.

A short, sharp shock of perception. The realization that the world around is stuck in a perfect, synchronized loop. Everyone else seems blind to it, leaving a profound isolation in this awareness. It is the paranoia of seeing the cage but not being able to break it.

lyrics.en:
The same hour repeats itself in silence
The same door opens to the same violence
I counted the cycles until I lost track
The end is the beginning and it always comes back

Is this a prison or a stage
Is this a script or a cage
If every day is written in advance
Then nothing I do is ever by chance

Round and round the circuit bends
The pattern never meets its end
I see the loop behind the veil
A perfect and eternal jail

I tried to break the repetition once
I stepped aside and waited for the response
The system paused for half a breath
Then filled the gap like I was never there

If I am the only one who sees the repetition
Does the repetition even exist
Or am I the glitch in a flawless machine

Round and round the circuit bends
The pattern never meets its end
I see the loop behind the veil
A perfect and eternal jail

The loop continues
With or without me

Every morning they turn left at the same time
Every evening they speak the same line
I watched for days to find a mistake
But the pattern holds and I am awake

Is it them who are frozen in repetition
Or am I the one who broke from the system
If no one else sees the loop that I see
Then the error is either them or me

They move the same
They speak the same
Identical days
No one is changed

I tried to mimic the motion they keep
I tried to enter the synchronized sleep
But my limbs respond to a different call
And my voice does not echo theirs at all

Something is watching
Something is keeping them in line
And it does not know I can see

They move the same
They speak the same
Identical days
No one is changed

I do not know if they are the prisoners
Or I am the one already condemned

descricao.en: The same morning. The same cold coffee. The same impending doom. It is the purest form of exhaustion and paranoia, where a new plan is tried and fails, while a mysterious crack in the system offers a glimpse of something else.

An ancient desert civilization. A prophet of doom in a land that refuses to listen. The isolation of speaking a truth no one wants to hear, and the heavy burden of watching the inevitable unfold from a distance.

A space station, the first target before the world below. A claustrophobic and high-stakes attempt to hack the system and evacuate the innocent. It is the brutal dilemma of trying to buy time against a machine that fights back, knowing the station is destined to burn.

A quiet and melancholic return to the homeworld, before the fire. The heavy weight of allegiance and the desperate attempt to save a doomed world. It is the heartbreaking acceptance that the loop will eventually pull him away again, leaving only the realization that the war remains the same, and only the sky changes.

An intergalactic archaeologist from a peaceful, bureaucratic civilization. He investigates dead planets in search of lost civilizations. Obsessed with his work, he is a solitary man who feels more at home among ruins and dust than among the living. The ultimate seeker of truth, driven by a stubborn refusal to give up, even when the truth he uncovers is ignored by his own people. The sound is defined by progressive rock. It features hypnotic riffs, a distorted bass driving the rhythm, and tribal, mathematical drums. The vocals are deep and intense, balancing between a controlled whisper and a powerful release. It is the sound of discovery, dust, and ancient stones.
The heavy silence of a choice made long ago. It is the quiet certainty of a soul that traded a normal life for the cold vastness of the stars and the dust of forgotten ruins.

descricao.en: The routine, the method, and the frustration of the search. Lonely scans and drillings on a dead planet. It captures the relentless repetition of looking for signs of life in the stone, dealing with the silence of the universe and the slow, methodical process of reading the ground.

The shift from routine to wonder. The slow, careful uncovering of something that was never meant to be found. It is the awe and the eerie silence of walking through a civilization that time forgot, where the dust holds secrets older than memory itself.

The investigation of a tragedy. Digging through the remnants of a horrific end, a theory begins to form. But the evidence refuses to align. It is a descent into forensic detail, paranoia, and the heavy burden of uncovering a truth that does not perfectly fit.

The discovery of a truth that was never meant to be found. An account of something impossible, buried in the dust of a dead world. It is the crushing weight of knowing, and the quiet tragedy of being ignored by those who refused to listen. A legacy left behind for a future that may never come.

A high-octane fusion of Surf Rock, Dark Western, and Desert Rock. Built on fast-paced drums, distorted basslines, and relentless tremolo picking, the sound is raw and cinematic. The vocals are aggressive and shouted, cutting through layers of heavy fuzz to create an intense, driving atmosphere.

A raw transmission from the wasteland. Engine roars and distorted riffs collide in a relentless display of speed and aggression. No clean vocals, no slow moments, just the pure, unfiltered sound of the chase.

descricao.en: The silence in a world that screams. Living in a dystopian, colonized urban center, she represents the psychological erosion caused by an oppressive regime. While the world reacts with anger, this is the slow, agonizing dissolution of identity. Suffering from memory loss and depersonalization, it is someone standing at their own front door, holding a key that no longer fits, wondering if they ever belonged there at all. The sound is defined by darkwave, coldwave, EBM, and minimal synthwave. Cold, hypnotic, and club-oriented, it is driven by pulsating basslines and atmospheric synths. The vocal delivery is dry, distant, and intimate, narrating the horror of looking into a mirror and not recognizing the face staring back. It is the sound of the void.

Fragmented memories of a past that might not be real. The terrifying void of recognizing familiar faces but feeling nothing. It culminates in front of a mirror that reflects nothing but the initial shock of losing oneself.

descricao.en: The full dissolution of existence. A reality where every familiar space becomes alien, and the reflection of a life once lived now belongs to someone else. It is the claustrophobic horror of being erased from existence, carrying the unbearable question of who is left when the identity is gone.

A short, sharp shock of perception. The realization that the world around is stuck in a perfect, synchronized loop. Everyone else seems blind to it, leaving a profound isolation in this awareness. It is the paranoia of seeing the cage but not being able to break it.

lyrics.en:
The same hour repeats itself in silence

descricao.en: The reconstruction of a shattered identity. Gathering the sharp fragments of what was lost, learning to accept the cracks, and finding that a fractured mirror can still reflect.
